data.app_name: The Pirate Queen with Lucy Liu
data.description:
Embark on an epic journey through the turbulent waters of history in "The Pirate Queen", with Lucy Liu 🌟

![{"height":224,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/38982662_7513468888773292_7586277367396825871_n.png?_nc_cat=105&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=3Fry611lhlwQ7kNvgH-ECQV&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYAFHDSNJ9C-YYuJKvNll4Jv5VQDsJZb70W2tlbFqnsx-Q&oe=6748549C)

Step into the boots of the legendary pirate Cheng Shih and see if you have what it takes to become history's most powerful pirate  🏴‍☠️


![{"height":910,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/39036653_1456869748359051_7076517034930849202_n.png?_nc_cat=111&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=qzaSVGX-9G4Q7kNvgEci5FL&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYCAypoLeNRimH7o5aXy2kHb9Dk2AwV2KyUBn2xAI5vp7w&oe=67485E24)


Travel back in time with this immersive story, perfect for explorers of all ages. Whether you're seeking a fresh adventure, yearning to escape into another world, or eager to unearth a hidden gem from history, this legend is for you.

![{"height":910,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/39003263_961033948683270_8273646164126363713_n.png?_nc_cat=111&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=7pDC1vgzKDgQ7kNvgFCwG1G&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYB90-Mm70y29hN7WKqqDMXAtIhzzqvLzmdm3ZP8wRvCBQ&oe=67484587)

With light gameplay elements, the focus is on the narrative. Dive into a story-rich experience lasting 1-4 hours ⏳, climb rigging, explore moonlit cabins 🌙, unearth hidden artefacts, and exercise your wit to become leader of the Red Flag Fleet.  

![{"height":910,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/39031579_801519894943640_3850714342256227051_n.png?_nc_cat=100&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=XApTrLOA6J4Q7kNvgGKKrc3&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYB9dWuEHHMWebMRPpAfJVgBG-jA2OYsYE0mWo8aFjiH0Q&oe=67483866)

![{"height":231,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/39031400_1653444588750690_8451663376835143463_n.png?_nc_cat=105&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=dAMMltjrQqMQ7kNvgF1LYSg&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYAhNyfn8KVg888nM-onmAlO23cA8tZ6MonQJz4Yo4YWfw&oe=674864D8)

Celebrated for its cinematic story and historical environments, this non-combat experience has earned critical acclaim, winning the Tribeca Storyscapes Award (2023) & the Raindance Discovery Award (2021) 🏆

![{"height":910,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-iad3-1.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/75322595_315227141608157_6664541123259039926_n.png?_nc_cat=104&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=T20YagAYjVkQ7kNvgEtMdNi&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-iad3-1.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYA1NrZ2o1b0Er7Br3ZVo5DzP1_vgLrHkHOvU01y4MlIxw&oe=67486159)


![{"height":225,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/38974820_419365674368364_6471370540204954427_n.png?_nc_cat=106&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=oAX67QRAIg0Q7kNvgEREsdC&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYA26qLQ66b_RGcaoJfq2stmF3DkUawluUPcNljESTd3Xg&oe=67484770)

Experience the captivating performance from Hollywood actress Lucy Liu 🎭, who brings Cheng Shih's character to life, under the direction of critically acclaimed filmmaker and creative director Eloise Singer 🎬


![{"height":910,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-iad3-1.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/57569455_779145490949371_5639970595016054333_n.png?_nc_cat=102&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=O0H6jKI95DoQ7kNvgESuZ5F&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-iad3-1.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYAjo3-CaL5xNvN7zVv_5cgDWN905ZzhlxzKgpD5uWjlOg&oe=67486A2A)

![{"height":244,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-iad3-1.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/75593949_1392764491611640_7662168618929982906_n.png?_nc_cat=108&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=LMRspbHi9TwQ7kNvgHZ_dyZ&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-iad3-1.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYDacjC1sLxlJtLoXy0ySXU6pscr7l_wqoI190xajn2CVQ&oe=67484597)

Are you ready to turn the tides of history? Let's see how well you fare as The Pirate Queen! 🏴‍☠️👑



![{"height":910,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/75251817_478868781249664_4666816330504461518_n.png?_nc_cat=105&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=ph1t6AnamugQ7kNvgEs2u11&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYBFmKO31jNT-cOx1eW9X2PZvwlFd4OVpta1slCgyCBWDg&oe=6748610C)
